curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: identify singular nouns which require the addition of -s or - es to form plural

mission.title: identify singular nouns which require the addition of -s or - es to form plural

interactions.retryHint: For many cats, keep cat and add s.

interactions.feedback: Correct! Bus ends in s, so add -es: buses.
interactions.retryHint: A word ending in s often needs -es.

interactions.prompt: Which plural is made by adding only -s to book?
interactions.retryHint: Say book, then add the /s/ sound.

interactions.prompt: Choose the correct plural for box.
interactions.feedback: Well done! Box ends in x, so we add -es.
interactions.retryHint: Words ending in x need -es here.

interactions.prompt: A shop has one dish and three ___.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Dish ends in sh, so add -es.
interactions.retryHint: Listen to the ending /sh/; it needs -es.

interactions.feedback: Super! You know when to add -s and when to add -es.
interactions.retryHint: Cup takes -s; watch ends in ch and takes -es.
